description: Reference package for rebuilding korean-law-mcp statute search as a MyTeam directREST skill. Not runtime-enabled and not legal advice.

failure_modes.message: Case law, administrative rules, and interpretation examples are not part of this P0 reference package.
Legal result lacks official source metadata.
Law name, article, paragraph, or effective date could not be verified.
Korean Law MCP or upstream law API is unavailable.

rules: P0 scope is statute search, article lookup, and official source display.
Do not present case law, administrative rules, or interpretation examples as available in this package.
Do not present legal output as attorney advice.
Show law name, article, paragraph when available, effective date, official source, and verification status.
Prefer official National Law Information Center or Ministry of Government Legislation sources.
If citation verification fails, mark the result failed rather than partial.
When user action has legal consequence, advise consulting a qualified professional.
Do not expose externalMCP as App Store runtime; externalMCPLater is only a future power-user or direct-download option.
